name: worker-fail-test-278d4f50a4/invalid-async-send-in-foreach-e
spec_references: Statements: "[Foreach]"; "Currently only supports range, list, map, string and XML subtypes, and [iterable objects]"
Expressions: "[Start action]" and "[Wait action]"; named workers, worker asynchronous send, and worker receive actions are absent from the supported lists.
reason: The negative case requires named workers and rejection of asynchronous worker communication within a foreach. These essential worker constructs and their validation behavior are not covered by subset 10; supported range foreach and arithmetic do not bring worker communication into scope.
unsupported_constructs: Named worker declarations (worker w1 and worker w2)
Asynchronous worker send ("20" -> w2) and worker receive (<- w1), including communication validation inside foreach
test_design_notes: Both communication lines have @error markers. The sent string and int receive also introduce a type mismatch alongside the intended invalid communication placement; no @args, @panic, or @output assertions occur.
